author: @shackdaddy7106
text: Anthony Richardson is a joke. The Colts were stupid to draft him. Not only did he not deserve to be drafted in the first round. He did not deserve to be drafted at all. He was a mediocre quarterback of Florida was an injury machine. He has been a mediocre quarterback for the Colts, who is still an injury machine. Sure went healthy. He can run fast and jump high and throw the ball a long way. But that doesn’t mean he could play football. That’s why to me the combine is a joke. The only thing it’s good for is to get a bunch of the college players and one place so they can be interviewed by teams that might be interested in drafting them. But as far as a physical test, they mean nothing because they don’t show if they can play football. Regarding the field goal rule for kicks over 60 yards. I like it four points for a good kick, but take away a point if they miss it. That would make the decision very interesting.
